checks: All four adapters complete the three ordinary construction/fault/save/reopen workflows with semantic and numerical parity
Five circuits, two conditions and twenty measured edits/Verify calls per combination; four live and Verify probes
Fresh results require increased run and electrical revision with matching non-stale result identity
Every p95 backend edit-to-fresh-result is below 500 ms; every Verify maximum is below 2 s
Graph definitions, model IDs, engine versions, settings, probe IDs and verified horizons match across adapters
Verify preserves paused live physics; successful records are excluded from retention; all owned sessions close via public app.close
Complete root/native lint, race and vet checks pass after final harness edits; runtime sources and package are unchanged
limits_of_evidence: command start includes admission/transport/JSON overhead and is a conservative backend upper bound; it is not input-to-visible acknowledgment
fresh means a fresh owned session with the reference circuit prepared; OS/filesystem caches are not purged and process-launch time is excluded
warm means one owned session after an unmeasured edit/Verify; successful records are excluded from project retention between repetitions and may be evicted by the ordinary bounded store
the three reference families, DC/pulse NPN variants and a mixed flasher are tested on one recorded workstation; no universal hardware or UI performance claim
At least 20 observations supports the specified nearest-rank empirical percentiles, not a population confidence bound
Visible acknowledgment/frame timing, deliberately difficult solves, capacity/hardware generalization, accessibility, clean distribution and participant gates remain open
DC LED/NPN Verify is an operating point; only RC, pulse NPN and flasher Verify spans 200 ms at 1 ms sampling
